The change that made the setting take effect is commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae` (PR #1920 in openmrs-esm-core, "(fix) O3-6028: Pass locationsPerRequest to the login location picker and drop numberToShow"). The line that passes it to the picker is `openmrs-esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`, where `locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}`. Before the fix, the picker was never given this value, so it fell back to its default of 50 (`openmrs-esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:27`).

Supporting evidence:
- The changeset describes the fix and the removal of the unused `numberToShow` property (`openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md:5`).
- The config schema defines `locationsPerRequest` (`openmrs-esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:44`, type at line 166).
- The picker's default of 50 and its use in `useLocations` and the infinite-scroll trigger are at `openmrs-esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:19`, `:27`, `:42` and `:68`.
- Tests confirm the configured value reaches the picker, and that zero falls back to 1 (`openmrs-esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-457`).

I took the repository names as `openmrs-esm-core`, `openmrs-esm-login-app` and `openmrs-esm-styleguide`, since that is how the question writes them. Falkon's paths use the `packages/apps/...` and `packages/framework/...` layout within `openmrs-esm-core`. I did not open the full files; the line numbers come from the grep matches.
